_about: Starter rituals for long-distance couples. The Ritual Builder may only suggest these (by id), with light personal variations. cost is what the ritual itself needs; nothing here requires a booking. minutes is a typical length; energy is how much it asks of a tired person.

rituals.name: Same-recipe cook-along
rituals.setup: Pick one recipe together; each of you gets the ingredients beforehand.
rituals.description: Cook the same dish at the same time on video, then eat it 'together' at the end.

rituals.name: Video breakfast date
rituals.setup: Whatever breakfast or snack you already have.
rituals.description: Eat a meal at the same time on video. With a time difference, one of you has breakfast while the other has dinner.

rituals.name: Mystery-ingredient challenge
rituals.setup: Each of you names one ingredient from your own kitchen that the other must use.
rituals.description: Improvise a dish around each other's challenge ingredient, then give the results a dramatic tasting review.

rituals.name: Tea or coffee tasting
rituals.setup: Two drinks each, from your own cupboard.
rituals.description: Make a drink at the same time and rate it like fancy critics: aroma, notes, overall vibe.

rituals.name: Co-watch one episode
rituals.setup: A show on a streaming service you both already have; press play on the count of three.
rituals.description: Watch one episode at the same time with the call open, and react together.

rituals.name: Synced movie night
rituals.setup: A film on a service you both already have; snacks from home.
rituals.description: A full movie in sync, with a short 'review' afterwards.

rituals.name: Favorite-video swap
rituals.setup: Each picks three short videos the other has never seen.
rituals.description: Take turns sharing your screen and showing each other something that made you laugh.

rituals.name: Virtual museum walk
rituals.setup: A free online museum or gallery tour.
rituals.description: Wander a museum together online and each pick the one piece you'd take home.

rituals.name: Online co-op word game
rituals.setup: A free two-player word game in the browser.
rituals.description: Work together on a cooperative word puzzle against the clock.

rituals.name: Twenty questions, couple edition
rituals.setup: Nothing.
rituals.description: Classic twenty questions, but the answers are things from your shared life.

rituals.name: Trivia about us
rituals.setup: Each writes five questions about your relationship beforehand.
rituals.description: Quiz each other on your own history. Points for the best wrong answers.

rituals.name: Slow chess (or checkers)
rituals.setup: A free online board you can leave open for days.
rituals.description: One or two moves a day, with a little trash talk on each move.

rituals.name: Draw-and-guess
rituals.setup: A free drawing game, or paper held up to the camera.
rituals.description: Take turns drawing prompts for the other to guess, as fast as you can.

rituals.name: Build a shared playlist
rituals.setup: A music app you already use.
rituals.description: Each add songs in turn and tell the story behind each one.

rituals.name: Photo scavenger hunt
rituals.setup: Phones and a list of five prompts you write for each other.
rituals.description: Head out (or around the house) to capture each other's prompts, then swap photos.

rituals.name: Sketch each other over video
rituals.setup: Paper and a pen.
rituals.description: Draw each other's portrait from the video call in ten minutes, then the big reveal.

rituals.name: Story relay
rituals.setup: Nothing, or a shared doc.
rituals.description: Build a silly story together, one sentence each, starring the two of you.

rituals.name: Letter swap: a favorite memory
rituals.setup: Paper or a doc; read them aloud on your next call.
rituals.description: Each writes a short letter about one favorite memory together, then you read them to each other.

rituals.name: Snail-mail letter
rituals.setup: Paper, an envelope, and a stamp.
rituals.description: A real letter in the post, with a doodle or something small and flat tucked inside.

rituals.name: Morning voice note
rituals.setup: Your phone.
rituals.description: Record a short voice note for them to wake up to. Time differences make this easy.

rituals.name: Open-when notes
rituals.setup: A shared doc or a few envelopes.
rituals.description: Write a few 'open when you…' notes (miss me, can't sleep, had a win) for the other to save.

rituals.name: Bedtime read-aloud
rituals.setup: A book or article you already have.
rituals.description: One reads a chapter aloud while the other gets cozy. Swap readers each night.

rituals.name: Three good things
rituals.setup: Nothing.
rituals.description: Before sleep, each shares three small good moments from the day.

rituals.name: Fall-asleep call
rituals.setup: Headphones; leave the call on as you wind down.
rituals.description: Keep the call going quietly while one or both of you drift off.

rituals.name: Goodnight sky swap
rituals.setup: Your phone camera.
rituals.description: Each sends a photo of the sky outside right now, whatever time it is there, with one line about your day.
